label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Poulter Knee Injury
items.text: Ian Poulter tore his knee meniscus hopping up two steps at a LIV Golf event and will need surgery in September but is still competing while managing pain.

items.headline: Scheffler Headlines Memorial
items.text: World No. 1 Scottie Scheffler will defend his Memorial Tournament title June 4 at Muirfield Village; Rory McIlroy and others headline the field while Viktor Hovland withdrew before entry deadline.

items.headline: Rolapp's 2028 Tour Plan Faces Criticism
items.text: PGA Tour COO Brian Rolapp’s plan to split the 2028 schedule into 'track one' and 'track two' events faces player backlash as it may prevent stars like Scheffler and Spieth from playing legacy tournaments simultaneously held on different tracks.
